events.title: Inaugural Thanksgiving Mass & Committee Assembly
events.venue: St. Mary's Main School Grounds & Chapel
events.description: Solemn inaugural gathering exclusively for school members, teaching and non-teaching staff, Sisters, and the Managing Committee. Features Holy Eucharistic Mass of Thanksgiving, blessing of the Golden Jubilee Memorial, and committee felicitation.

events.title: Observation of Golden Jubilee — Day 1: Grand Celebrations & Alumni Homecoming
events.venue: Father Marian Memorial Auditorium & Campus Grounds
events.description: Official public observation of the 50th Golden Jubilee open for all alumni, students, parents, and well-wishers. Features the grand jubilee assembly, global alumni homecoming spanning batches 1976–2025, felicitation of retired teachers, campus memory walk, and evening cultural musical concert.
events.chiefGuest: Distinguished Alumni Association Patrons & State Dignitaries

events.title: Observation of Golden Jubilee — Day 2: Grand Cultural Fest & Valedictory Gala
events.venue: Central Jubilee Arena & Open Air Amphitheatre
events.description: Grand Day 2 observation of the Golden Jubilee showcasing student dance drama, classical Odissi recitals, release of the 50th Anniversary Commemorative Souvenir ("Golden Pages"), awards ceremony, and grand jubilee valedictory banquet.
events.chiefGuest: Honorable State Education Dignitaries & Principal Sr. Indu Turkey

timeline.title: Foundation of St. Mary's School
timeline.description: Established under the visionary patronage of Cuttack Roman Catholic Diocesan Corporation (CRCDC) Archdiocese of Cuttack-Bhubaneswar to bring quality English medium education to Jajpur Road.

timeline.title: Stewardship of the Sisters of Handmaids of Mary
timeline.description: The Sisters joined the mission, instilling disciplined values, compassion, moral stewardship, and establishing our motto: "Service Through Excellence".

timeline.title: Affiliation with CISCE / ICSE New Delhi
timeline.description: The school gained formal affiliation with the Council for the Indian School Certificate Examinations (CISCE). The pioneer batch produced outstanding state ranks.

timeline.title: Inauguration of Modern Science Complex
timeline.description: Dedicated Physics, Chemistry, and Biology laboratories inaugurated alongside a state-of-the-art computer education facility.

timeline.title: Silver Jubilee Celebration (25 Years)
timeline.description: Celebrated a quarter-century of educational brilliance with the construction of the Silver Jubilee Academic Block and the first grand Alumni meet.

timeline.title: ISRO Educational Visits by Students
timeline.description: Marian students embarked on prestigious study and educational visits to the Indian Space Research Organisation (ISRO), exploring satellite launch technology, space applications, and fostering scientific inquiry and innovation.

timeline.title: Auditorium & Multipurpose Sports Ground
timeline.description: Inauguration of Father Marian Multipurpose Auditorium, standard basketball and volleyball courts, expanding cultural and physical training programs.

timeline.title: Smart Digital Classrooms & STEM Labs
timeline.description: Transformation into interactive smart classrooms equipped with multimedia visual aids, digital coding labs, and enriched library archives.

timeline.title: Eco-Green Campus & Golden Jubilee Project Initiation
timeline.description: Installation of rooftop solar infrastructure, rainwater harvesting, and rollout of the Golden Jubilee Multipurpose Student Centre project.

timeline.title: State-Level Chess Competition
timeline.description: St. Mary's School proudly hosted the prestigious State-Level Chess Championship, bringing together budding chess prodigies and school teams from across Odisha to showcase tactical mastery and sportsmanship.

timeline.title: The Golden Jubilee: 50 Glorious Years of Excellence
timeline.description: Half a century of nurturing leaders, doctors, engineers, educators, civil servants, and honest citizens. Proudly celebrating 1976 – 2026!

announcements.text: ✨ Welcome to the 50th Golden Jubilee (1976–2026) of St. Mary's School, Jajpur Road! Dec 16: School Members & Committee | Dec 17 & 18: Grand Golden Jubilee Observation.
📢 Alumni Global Meet RSVP is open for Batches 1976–2025 for the Golden Jubilee Observation on Dec 17 & 18. Please RSVP on the Events tab.
